notes_extra: 150gr Berger Classic Hunter, HBN plated. 102% load density. Jump .025. 6 ES, 2 SD typical. 25 in 9 twist Bartlein #3b, SAAMI zero freebore. Shot at 200 yards from a hunting bag.
